# Vercel: get edge configs

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Vercel Edge Configs allow you to read configuration data at the edge without deploying new code. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact endpoint path for reading configs. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact required parameters and their types. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact authentication method and token format. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact response shape and status codes for success and failure cases.

Search intents:
- Vercel edge config API parameters
- Vercel edge config authentication format
- Vercel edge config response format

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-edge-configs --json
